cohort: 280 women who received either spinal or Entonox analgesia during labor at Shahid Akbarabadi Hospital.
finding: Spinal analgesia was associated with a shorter first stage of labor and lower pain scores compared to Entonox analgesia, without significant differences in cesarean section rates, Apgar scores, or other neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Measured but no significant difference between groups
